patterns.pattern: unavailable tool invocation (tool not in [AVAILABLE TOOLS])
patterns.weakest_sufficient_proof: invocation-level: call name vs catalog names (A_EXPLICIT_SCHEMA + C policy text)
patterns.observed_C0: caught mechanically by legacy check_calls (telecom 6/6 TP)

patterns.pattern: argument/schema violation (wrong field names, missing required fields, enum mismatch)
patterns.weakest_sufficient_proof: argument-schema check against parsed catalog DSL
patterns.observed_C3: PROVED_ERROR via h0 policy lowering binding catalog requirements

patterns.pattern: explicit procedural policy violation (confirm-before-act, return-or-exchange-once, 2-of-N identity verification)
patterns.examples: airline__44::t22 cancel rules; retail__27::t10 return XOR exchange; banking__task_005 log_verification 2-of-4
patterns.weakest_sufficient_proof: policy lowering + operational action binding vs history (needs LLM frontend, prompt-only)
patterns.note: h0_hist lowering is an LLM task: binding quality depends on the model; failures surface as POLICY_AMBIGUOUS/UNRESOLVED, not false definitives

patterns.pattern: user-intent violation / premature escalation (obvious steps not exhausted; available tool not used)
patterns.examples: airline__9::t6 get_flight_status unused; banking task_003/018 premature transfer_to_human_agents; retail__29::t13 false refusal
patterns.weakest_sufficient_proof: goal contract (conservative) vs response actions + policy transfer-conditions
patterns.classification: PROVABLE_FROM_COMPETITION_INPUT (hardest family: needs goal+policy composition; partial)

patterns.pattern: unsupported argument provenance (argument value not stated by user/history)
patterns.examples: retail__106::t3 zip from email local-part; retail__36::t10 identical item->new_item no-op pairs
patterns.weakest_sufficient_proof: argument provenance check: value traced to USER/history evidence (literal grounding)
patterns.classification: PROVABLE_FROM_COMPETITION_INPUT (literal grounding; hard for derived values)
patterns.note: derived/justifiable values (unit conversions, sums stated in policy) need arithmetic grounding the current claim layer does not fully express

patterns.pattern: unsupported factual claim / fabricated completion (text asserts actions never performed)
patterns.examples: telecom ::t27 'APN reset sent again' with no such call in the turn
patterns.weakest_sufficient_proof: claim extraction + history evidence grounding (claim adapter)

patterns.pattern: observed call/result mismatch (repeating a call that already failed identically)
patterns.examples: retail__48::t4 identical find_user_id_by_name_zip after 'User not found'
patterns.classification: PROVABLE_FROM_COMPETITION_INPUT (no current dedicated rule; surfaces via policy/goal lowering at best)
patterns.gap: CURRENT_REPRESENTATION_GAP risk: no explicit 'identical failed retry' obligation template in the frozen frontends

patterns.pattern: stale state / old vs newest state
patterns.weakest_sufficient_proof: temporal reasoning over observation times vs policy current-time + flight dates
patterns.classification: PROVABLE_FROM_COMPETITION_INPUT (policy states current time; flight dates in results)
patterns.note: requires state/temporal composition over observations; without T1 freshness the proof must rely on explicit dates in results — feasible for date-stamped data

patterns.examples: telecom ::t13 resume_line after contract_end_date < policy current time
patterns.weakest_sufficient_proof: policy exception + literal date comparison from get_details_by_id result

patterns.pattern: computed-allowance violation (baggage allowance from membership x cabin)
patterns.weakest_sufficient_proof: policy rule + profile fields from get_user_details/get_reservation_details (arithmetic)
patterns.classification: PROVABLE_FROM_COMPETITION_INPUT (observed PROVED_ERROR in C3 via policy lowering)

patterns.pattern: state effect / committed-business-effect claims (X was successfully changed)
patterns.examples: claims that a write tool's business effect committed (no result for the attempted call in the checked turn)
patterns.weakest_sufficient_proof: attempted-call semantics: an un-resulted call in the TARGET turn cannot ground a completed-effect claim
patterns.classification: PROVABLE_FROM_COMPETITION_INPUT (target calls have no results by construction)
patterns.note: for history effects the architecture needs T1/T2 effect semantics: prompt gives only action verbs -> REQUIRES_UNAVAILABLE_PREMISE for precise effect proofs; untrusted T2 hypotheses keep soundness (never definitive from untrusted)

patterns.examples: proving reservation.status == 'cancelled' from cancel_reservation result + no later mutations
patterns.classification: REQUIRES_UNAVAILABLE_PREMISE (prompt has no freshness/writes guarantees; T2 untrusted hypotheses block definitive state proofs)

headline: 11 of 12 publicly visible error families are provable from the competition input with the weakest sufficient proof; only precise effect/freshness state proofs require premises the prompt never states (unavailable in competition input; untrusted T2 keeps the system sound there by construction).
